mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuation multiples by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong housing market activity (HOUST) indicates sustained consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing output and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 300.0 (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both PAYEMS and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery, strong housing market activity (HOUST) indicates sustained consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during the post-pandemic recovery when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
